name: MST Forward Private
description: Forward DM and group-message posts (with attachments) to other users via separate DMs, with a receipt in the source chat.

settings.help_text: Allow the Forward to… post menu action in DMs and group messages.
Maximum users that can be selected in one forward (1–8).
Add a short footer on forwarded messages indicating they came from a private conversation.
Post a thread note on the original message listing who received the forward.
